notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Open grassland with gentle hills, often overcast, occasional tree plantations and roads in worse shape than neighbours.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plain white plates with black characters; the western neighbour adds a black dot or blue bar.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The old Generation 3 car was black with no antenna, now largely overwritten; the picture is often smudgy.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Thick wooden signposts, usually painted white, with up to four rectangular notches at the back.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Double yellow lines with white dashes between them; seen nowhere else in the Americas.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: White bollards with one side often painted yellow, plus stone barriers.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Trident poles with three upward-pointing insulators at the top.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Round poles topped with flat metal sheets, and square concrete poles.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: Small yellow or red rectangular reflectors; supports have three rectangle sides plus corner bits of the fourth.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: A green-painted stone kilometre marker is unique.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are yellow with black arrows, unlike the neighbour with white and red.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Nearly all roads have at least a slight incline; fully flat land suggests the neighbour instead.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Reddish soil from light pink to deep red is common and less so across the border.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Cube-shaped concrete houses in drab, weathered colours, often with flat roofs.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Short stocky palms and lots of cattle, which outnumber people four to one.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Some of the tallest hills with lots of exposed rock and heavy bush around Minas.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Tall hills with noticeably darker soil in the far north, without exposed rock.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Tree plantations are especially dense in the north and northwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The southeast near the lagoon and the border is noticeably flat.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Bins with orange lids are specific to Rocha.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Divided highways exist only near the capital, east to the beach resort, west and north.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Seaside resort with many tall modern apartment towers, a big sandy beach and villa areas with tall pines.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 4 truck coverage with a white blur and antenna is centred on the capital; smallcam elsewhere.
